title: Medication as a means to an end rather than the end itself
description: Medication for mental health can be a powerful tool that improves lives. At Grovewood, medication is one of the tools available to help you feel and function at your best. We take the time to understand your unique situation, carefully weigh the benefits and risks of each option, and work with you to help you feel like yourself again. That's the Grovewood Difference.
